messages:
maya: Quick thread — we need a compact DP playbook to recruit 6–8 partners, run two parallel 2-week pilots, and make launch decisions. Focus: clear pass/fail, minimal infra churn.

anton: Agreed. Suggest small stipend or credits and a one-page SOW addendum for customers who need extra controls.

linh: I'll own 30m scoping workshops (must/should/nice). Will capture critical prompts and success metrics.

ravi: Note: HSM/KMS requests trigger security review (~10 business days). Flag early in outreach.

maya: Proposed pass criteria (short): SDK + sample app deployed; 2 core flows exercised; quality delta <=2% on agreed prompts OR median latency <300ms. Require partner demo at end.

samir: Infra: reserve a short demo burst (200 rps) and define fallback model with degraded-labeling. Also provide a per-partner Grafana link.

anton: I'll make a simple 1-5 Impact/Urgency/Feasibility scorecard for ask prioritization.

ops-bot: Calendar: 'DP Scoping Workshops' tentative next Wed 10:00–12:00 — invites sent to owners.

maya: Owners: anton=outreach+scorecard, linh=scoping+spreadsheet, samir=infra+dashboards, ravi=legal/SOW. Milestones: outreach + SOW sketch by Tue EOD; scoping sessions next week; onboard first cohort by month-end.

ravi: Starting SOW draft now and looping security.

maya: I'll post outreach DM + packet draft tomorrow for signoff. Keep the pilot instrumented and light. :rocket:
